members.name: price
members.doc: Price of the level.

members.name: size
members.doc: Size resting at that price, in the base asset.

types.name: OrderBookProps
types.doc: A live order book: bids on the left, asks on the right, best prices meeting in the middle. A depth bar behind each row shows the cumulative size up to it, and a row flashes when its size changes. When the price moves, rows slide to their new place instead of jumping. Hover or focus a row to see what it takes to trade through to it; click one to select its price.

members.name: bids
members.doc: Buy orders. Any order: the highest price is drawn first.

members.name: asks
members.doc: Sell orders. Any order: the lowest price is drawn first.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the book, such as "BTC-USD order book".

members.name: depth
members.doc: Rows shown per side.

members.name: baseSymbol
members.doc: Code of the asset sizes are counted in, such as "BTC".

members.name: quoteSymbol
members.doc: Code of the asset prices are quoted in, such as "USD".

members.name: pricePrecision
members.doc: Decimal places of a price.

members.name: sizePrecision
members.doc: Decimal places of a size.

members.name: selectedPrice
members.doc: Selected price, or null for none. Leave undefined to let the book keep its own selection.

members.name: defaultSelectedPrice
members.doc: Price selected at first when the book keeps its own selection.

members.name: onSelectLevel
members.doc: Called with the level that was clicked, or with null when the selected level is clicked again.

members.name: locale
members.doc: Formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client render the same numbers.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.

members.name: mid
members.doc: Price the book starts around.

members.name: tick
members.doc: Price step between two levels.

members.name: levels
members.doc: Levels kept on each side.

members.name: size
members.doc: Typical size of a level near the best price.

members.name: interval
members.doc: Milliseconds between two ticks.

members.name: seed
members.doc: Seed of the generator. The same seed always replays the same session.

members.name: paused
members.doc: Stops the ticks while true.

members.name: bids
members.doc: Buy levels, best first.

members.name: asks
members.doc: Sell levels, best first.

members.name: running
members.doc: False while paused, while the tab is hidden, or when the person asked for reduced motion.

members.name: ref
members.doc: AnimatePresence measures the row through this ref when it leaves.
